note: Edge and CDN providers. They can host edge code and sit in front of any other provider; add them with --also to put them in front of a plan.

any: Runs your containers on managed Kubernetes in Akamai Cloud.

any.caveat: Adds Kubernetes you would have to operate.

any: Receives HTTPS traffic and forwards it to your application.
Akamai Ion CDN with App & API Protector
Serves cached content close to users and filters malicious requests.
A private network for your servers and databases.
Akamai Cloud Managed Databases for PostgreSQL
Akamai Cloud Managed Databases for MySQL
S3-compatible object storage for files, uploads and backups.
GPU machines for hosting your own models.

gaps.serverless: Akamai EdgeWorkers run small edge scripts, not full apps; use LKE for the application.
gaps.cache: Run Redis in a container on LKE, or use a partner service.
gaps.secrets: Use Kubernetes Secrets on LKE, or an external secrets manager.
gaps.observability: Use your own Prometheus and Grafana, or a partner service.

server: Runs your containers on Cloudflare's network, started from a Worker.

server.caveat: Check the current status of Cloudflare Containers (it was introduced as a beta) before depending on it.

serverless: Runs your code at the edge per request and scales automatically.

serverless.caveat: Workers run JavaScript, TypeScript, Python and WebAssembly in a V8 isolate, not arbitrary containers, so frameworks may need an adapter.

any: Builds and serves your front end from Cloudflare's network.
Health-checks origins and steers traffic between them.
Cloudflare CDN, WAF and DDoS protection
Serves cached content close to users and filters malicious requests.
Cloudflare Hyperdrive with an external PostgreSQL
Pools and accelerates connections from Workers to a PostgreSQL run elsewhere (for example Neon or Supabase).

any.caveat: Cloudflare does not host PostgreSQL. Its own database, D1, is SQLite-based.

any: A global key-value store for cached data.

any.caveat: Workers KV is eventually consistent and is not Redis-compatible, so Redis client code needs changes.

any: S3-compatible object storage with no charge for data leaving it.
A vector index for embeddings, queried from Workers.
Encrypted values handed to your Workers.
Shows Worker logs and request analytics.
Hosted open models behind an API, run on Cloudflare's GPUs.

gaps.network: Use Cloudflare Tunnel to reach private origins without exposing them.
gaps.db_mysql: Use Hyperdrive with an external MySQL.
gaps.registry: Cloudflare Containers builds from your Dockerfile; no separate registry is needed.
gaps.identity: Use Cloudflare Access for staff, or a hosted sign-in service for customers.

any: Runs your Deno, Node.js and framework code on a global network, scaling per request.

any.caveat: Deno Deploy runs JavaScript and TypeScript apps, not arbitrary containers.

any: Serves your built front end from Deno's network.
Terminates TLS and routes requests to your app.
Serves your app close to users.

any.caveat: Deno KV is not Redis-compatible, so Redis client code needs changes.

any: Encrypted values handed to your app.
Shows logs and traces for your app.

gaps.db_postgres: Use Neon, Supabase or another hosted PostgreSQL.
gaps.db_mysql: Use PlanetScale or another hosted MySQL.
gaps.storage: Use Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3 or similar.
gaps.network: Deno Deploy has no private network; restrict data stores by credentials.
gaps.registry: Not needed: Deno Deploy builds from source.
gaps.identity: Use a hosted sign-in service such as Clerk or Auth0.

any: Runs your code at the edge per request, compiled to WebAssembly.

any.caveat: Fastly Compute runs WebAssembly modules (Rust, JavaScript, Go and others), not arbitrary containers.

any: Steers traffic between your origins with health checks.
Serves cached content close to users and filters malicious requests.
Hosts built static files and serves them from the CDN.
A key-value store readable from Fastly Compute.

any.caveat: Fastly KV Store is not Redis-compatible, so Redis client code needs changes.

any: Encrypted values readable from Fastly Compute.
Streams request logs to your logging tools in real time.

gaps.db_postgres: Fastly does not host databases; use a managed PostgreSQL elsewhere.
gaps.registry: Not applicable: Compute deploys WebAssembly packages.
gaps.network: Fastly has no private network for your data stores.
gaps.identity: Use a hosted sign-in service such as Clerk or Auth0.
